**Path switch returns the stored security capabilities**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | TS 33.501 / Procedures for AS algorithm selection / Xn-handover |
| Tags | negative, security |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 25s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | disruptive |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration, PDU session establishment |

## Clauses

- TS 33.501 6.7.3.1 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 names the target "gNB" and ends "Additionally, the AMF may log the event and may take additional measures, such as raising an alarm"; by V15.20.0 the target is "gNB/ng-eNB" and the last sentence "The AMF shall support logging capabilities for this event and may take additional measures, such as raising an alarm"; the two cited sentences are otherwise unchanged through V19.7.0)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-PATH-SWITCH-SECCAP-MISMATCH.md).
